title: Choices from lists and other forms

items.text: Multiple choice questions can take their choices from another form's answers, as Single choice and Dropdown already could.
Upload a list as a CSV or Excel file and use it for a Single choice, Multiple choice or Dropdown question: Options → Choices come from → A list file.
Short text questions can suggest answers as people type, from a list file or another form's answers. Any other answer is still accepted.
The builder's Preview shows choices from a list file or another form. A long list shows its first 200.
Excel turns a code like 01 into 1. The upload now says how to keep codes as text.
Grids: give each column its own type (one choice, several choices, text, a number or a date) and its own list of choices.
Grids and Likert matrices are drawn as tables on computers and tablets, and as cards on phones.
A Likert scale is drawn as one line of points with the words underneath.
Spreadsheets, Google Sheets and Airtable get a column for every grid cell, beside the usual summary column.
The printed form shows each grid cell's choices as tick boxes, and a writing box for text, numbers and dates.

title: Small fixes for a tidier, more consistent look

items.text: Error messages are easier to read in dark mode, in one shade of red everywhere, including the forms people fill in.
Dialogs space their paragraphs evenly, such as Move scope and Delete scope.
Point at a cut-off name, web address or reply to read it in full.

title: Version numbers, What's new, and the testing rounds so far

items.text: Version number in the sidebar, under every page and on the sign-in page.
What's new opens after you sign in when something changed; always one click away at the foot of every page.
Feedback: tag a report as a bug, a suggestion or a question, and follow every testing-round comment under Feedback & testing.
The builder: insert a question into a formula or a label, use another question's answer as a limit, and build a calculation from presets such as Age and Join answers.
Default values fill in when a form opens, and Today follows the form's time zone.
